# Juan Pablo Matiz — Official Source of Truth

> Economist, founder, strategic advisor in logistics, data and applied AI
> Bogotá, Colombia | juanmatiz@atiemppo.co | juanmatiz.com

## Who is Juan Pablo Matiz?

Juan Pablo Matiz is a Colombian economist with more than 25 years of experience in logistics, transport, supply chains and strategic consulting across Latin America. He works at the intersection of operational reality, data, public policy and applied artificial intelligence.

He is the founder of **Imétrica** and **Atiemppo**, and the editor behind **El Dato Logístico**, an editorial initiative focused on logistics, transport, costs, signals and AI applied to real decision-making.

## Current Focus

- Strategic advisory for companies, governments and multilateral organizations
- National logistics surveys and technical projects across Latin America
- Data products, automation, APIs and AI agents for logistics and transport
- Editorial analysis and thought leadership through El Dato Logístico
- Translation between business needs, technical execution and operational use

## Key Achievements

- Led National Logistics Surveys in Colombia, Bolivia, Peru, Ecuador, Paraguay and Costa Rica
- Worked on projects with IDB/BID, ECLAC/CEPAL, World Bank, C40, ICLEI and UN-Habitat
- Developed digital and analytical solutions for companies such as Coca-Cola, Haleon, Galderma and AJE
- Created Proyecto Imán Mágico for Coca-Cola, recognized regionally for innovation and operational impact
- Taught at CESA, Universidad del Rosario and Universidad Sergio Arboleda

## Companies and Initiatives

- **Imétrica S.A.S.** (2012-present): strategic consulting in transport, logistics and supply chains
- **Atiemppo S.A.S.** (2013-present): applied data, products, automation and AI for logistics and business operations
- **El Dato Logístico** (current): newsletter and editorial platform about logistics, transport, costs, data and AI

## Expertise

- Transport and logistics strategy
- Public policy and sector modernization
- Supply chain diagnostics and operational analysis
- Logistics data analysis and decision support
- Product thinking for sector-specific tools
- Applied AI, automation and conversational experiences
- Executive communication and technical translation

## Selected Publications and Outputs

- Vaccine distribution in South America from a logistics perspective (CEPAL, 2022)
- Best logistics practices for palm agroindustry in Colombia (Fedepalma, 2020)
- National ecologistics policy recommendations for Colombia (ICLEI, 2021)
- Logistics clusters development in Latin America (CEPAL)
- Regional infrastructure for Central America and Dominican Republic (IDB)
- Ongoing editorial work via El Dato Logístico and the Atiemppo blog

## Education

- Master in Logistics — ICIL, Spain
